title: Refactoring Core Architecture
text: Migrating our primary API services to a more modular structure to support future scalability. Focus on reducing dependency coupling.

title: FitTrack Beta Testing

title: Infrastructure Upgrade
text: Moved internal build pipelines to a self-hosted runner to improve CI/CD speed and security.
